title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037261023899 by rerouting role 230 on the #7674 banked caller
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This construction gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.0037261023899** on the exact 16-call saved-bank contract of #7674. Its directed lower point exceeds that proposal’s directed upper endpoint, 0.00372604555572, by **0.00000005683418**. The new raw crossing lies between 0.0037261023900 and 0.0037261023901. I request maintainer frontier review of this compatible gain. [Matched application](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e/research/p104-role230-banked/PROOF.md)

Rerouting role 230 from chart 730 to 912 and updating its partner signals preserves all fifteen of Ali Romman’s saved pivots. Over the complete caller, thirty-two rank-three payments become sixteen rank-two and sixteen rank-four payments. The paid count remains 101,824 and all 21,152 productive targets retain their ranks. Six additional local terms per native invocation incur ordinary costs. An extra rank-one recursive payment would exhaust the improvement. [Construction, invoice and replay](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e/research/p104-role230-banked)

## Task and overlap

The task refines `p104-side-correction` on canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The comparator is #7674 at `28b2af322a1fab01b3734365988930920f9dda48`. Its input is #7669’s canonical word `ee251f6005d2a92b887c5b804bd7aac05989d278b2c9ccb3c3091b50d533b08d`. Replaying the unchanged fifteen-pivot specification gives comparator graph `d81ec9f47740852a4bf7bd83100feff5cb66b70e1973466e1609bbac8af75098` and edited graph `1f082936ada08b5138b7d13e33368bd21c6f46632c5319a348e2f2a8e0021150`. [Exact task and credits](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e/research/p104-role230-banked/TASK.json) · [Coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19702865)

Ali Romman’s newly posted grid and stock audits tighten the comparator’s finite implementation. The former proves a minimum literal product/addition grid of 225 × 2¹² on the #7674 graph. The latter attains 2,425 snapshot slots and 2,430 total private homes for its fixed row order. This submission uses the proven common enlarged layout on both graphs. Applying either tighter result to the edited dependencies would require a fresh replay. [Parent minimum grid](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7680) · [Parent fixed-order snapshot allocation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7681)

## Validation

Run from the repository root with Python 3.12 and its standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-role230-banked --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-role230-banked
```

On a pristine checkout of this exact commit the metadata check passed, and the full registered run completed in 227.707 seconds with exit 0, empty stderr and all 69 file identities preserved. The optional saved-witness checker reproduced both controls in 20.97 seconds.

Both graph orders agreed after every pivot. The rational replay agreed on 7,640 exposed noninput rows in each direction, including 1,501 public outputs. The physical catalogue checked 3,025 actual forward graph pairs, five additional diagnostic orientations and all 512 columns in both directions for 19 maps. Both dense prime replays matched all 1,501 outputs. In the first, independent phase and sign mutations each changed 53 distinct public roles. A sign change compensated at every reader preserved the final operator but broke the third pivot’s saved witness by exactly −8. The signed caller passed all 54 strict and four functional outer predicates. [Two saved-witness controls](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e/research/p104-role230-banked/witness-controls/README.md) [Registered commands](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e/research/p104-role230-banked/VERIFY.json)

Both words receive the same exact-root format, 15,290 named private homes per native call, separate dummy and guarded temporary storage, and the complete positive costs of selecting, copying, restoring and retiring them. The proof also charges 3,536 negative-root translations. The all-width result retains native all-column realization, owned erasure, compiler closure, precision and tape movement, and analytic recovery. The complete recursive multiplier has yet to be materialized. The smaller 235-lifetime application has its own conditional gain and separate handoff. [Physical proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e/research/p104-role230-banked/PROOF.md) · [235-lifetime handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19703467)

## Credit and next review

Ali Romman supplied the fifteen pivots and bank program in #7674. SYLforge supplied the word and caller in #7669. The package preserves the operator, pricing, caller, fixed-tape and selected-result credits of their predecessors. Clear1nsight contributed the role-230 cut and matched application with substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance. The existing five-file CI prerequisite is ToikY’s original commit `0eabc624a9bc9ed2847719efd63390db4d297df4`. [Attribution](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1b4a4d6f9370b8c93b3f769a6229a9111ef3940e/research/p104-role230-banked/NOTICE)

The smallest independent frontier-review step is to reproduce the unchanged fifteen witnesses on the candidate, then inspect the two-leg copy between separately addressed slots and the common-root substitution in the full multiplier.
